# Ken Classes — Accredited Online Learning & Course Management Platform

> Ken Classes is an enterprise-scale online learning and course commerce delivery system providing industry-accredited curriculums, live interactive masterclasses, 1-on-1 mentor guidance, and cryptographically verified digital certificates.

## Primary System Domains

1. **Course Catalogue & Public Discovery** (`/courses`):
   - Comprehensive technical curricula across Modern Full-Stack Development, Cloud Computing, Distributed Systems, and AI/MLOps.
   - Interactive preview lessons, syllabus breakdowns, and prerequisite specifications.

2. **Accredited Verification Registry** (`/verify-certificate`):
   - Cryptographically verifiable credential lookups matching SHA-256 digital certificate hashes.
   - Authoritative verification for employers and academic institutions.

3. **Help & Support Center** (`/help`):
   - Bilingual FAQ repository (English and Hindi).
   - Direct support ticket submission with dedicated academic triage.

4. **Multi-Role RBAC Governance**:
   - Least-privilege role-based access for Students, Mentors, Content Managers, Finance Officers, Community Moderators, and Platform Administrators.
